questions.question: Which of the following terms was NOT originally included in the Preamble of the Indian Constitution adopted on November 26, 1949?

options.explanation: Sovereign was originally included in the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.

questions.explanation: The terms 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' were added to the Preamble by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976. The original Preamble contained 'Sovereign, Democratic Republic'.
